# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a portrait-first browser endless runner called **Neon Runner: Chad.exe Afterwork Arcade**. Preserve the source mechanics: fixed-position runner at the left, tap/click/space to jump only when grounded, gravity, moving ground obstacles, forgiving AABB collision, one point per obstacle passed, speed ramp every five points, fail-on-collision, and restart.

The new authored world is satirical vaporwave Y2K internet culture. The focal actor is Chad.exe, a glowing angular neon runner shard with visor pixels. Hazards are doomscroll pop-up spikes labeled AD/LAG/POP/RATIO. Score is a Meme Streak earned by clearing gates. Failure is Lag Crash. Use procedural Canvas for a synthwave grid road, striped sunset, scanline overlay, floating internet billboards, cyan/pink/gold glow, compact HUD, and one-thumb mobile onboarding.

Use catalog-approved remote Google fonts Audiowide, Exo 2, and Press Start 2P. Optional audio should use approved scifi/joyful catalog URLs and fail silently if blocked by mobile browser policies.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved game is a browser-native endless runner. The runner stays at roughly 15% screen width, gravity pulls it to a fixed ground line, tap/click/space triggers a jump only while grounded, obstacles scroll from right to left, AABB collision with a slightly shrunken player box ends the run, and score increments by one when an obstacle is passed. Game speed starts at 6 and increases by 0.5 every five scored obstacles. Start, game-over, and restart screens wrap the loop.

## Protected mechanics
- One-thumb tap/click/space jump input; no directional input or double jump.
- Gravity value, jump force, fixed player x, ground height, obstacle scrolling, spawn cadence, forgiving AABB collision, scoring on passed hazards, speed ramp, fail/restart state flow.
- Portrait mobile actionability and visible score/restart CTA.

## Regenerated identity
Neon Runner recasts the same mechanic truth as a vaporwave Y2K afterwork arcade sprint. The focal actor is Chad.exe, a neon shard runner wearing visor pixels. Hazards are doomscroll pop-up spikes, score is meme streak/gates cleared, failure is a lag crash, and the background is a procedural synthwave grid mall with glitch billboards.

## Implementation approach
The new canonical `index.html` is a self-contained Canvas/CSS/JS runtime. It demotes legacy Orbit Courier presentation to `index_old.html` and uses catalog-approved remote fonts and scifi/arcade audio URLs while keeping all gameplay logic inline and inspectable.
